## [Framework fomo](#framework-fomo)

Dig into [everything we announced at Framework](https://www.figma.com/blog/what-we-launched-at-framework-2024/)

, including a feature called Code Connect that links your design system to code, and the much-anticipated typography variables. Plus, catch up on the roundtable talks and expert Q&As in our event recap.

## [Peddle it like a product](#peddle-it-like-a-product)

Want your design system to be an essential part of your company’s toolkit? Start treating it like a product. In our latest on [the future of design systems](https://www.figma.com/blog/the-future-of-design-systems-is-marketing/)

, Ana Boyer unpacks how to drive internal buy-in and adoption across your organization. Discover how to ensure your design system becomes as indispensable as it is powerful.

[![A graphic shows cross-sections of a green circle snaking through blue squares on a bright yellow background.](data:image/png;base64,)![A graphic shows cross-sections of a green circle snaking through blue squares on a bright yellow background.](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/599r6htc/regionalized/5d412826ef70d0de59f4008931cd4e0eb92e6b10-1260x730.png?w=528&h=306&q=75&fit=max&auto=format)](https://www.figma.com/blog/the-future-of-design-systems-is-marketing/)

## [Design systems 101](#design-systems-101)

Not sure what all the fuss is about? For those yet to embark on their design system journey, we’ve put together an introductory series. The first two guides cover [what a design system is](https://www.figma.com/blog/design-systems-101-what-is-a-design-system/)

and how to build one of your own.

## [Fueling growth](#fueling-growth)

It’s fitting that Carvana, the leading online retailer for used cars, has a need for speed—and scale. Learn [how the team leveraged its design system](https://www.figma.com/blog/how-carvana-fuels-consistency-and-scale/)

to meet sky-rocketing customer demand during the pandemic, and how variables made it easy to keep design details consistent across the whole product.

[**Read more**](https://www.figma.com/blog/how-carvana-fuels-consistency-and-scale/)

## [Making headlines](#making-headlines)

Delivering the news in a clear, consistent way is top priority at _The Washington Post_, which maintains an ever-growing design system. When it comes to crafting new components, the team has instituted a [10-day sprint](https://www.figma.com/blog/the-anatomy-of-a-component-sprint/)

that’s run jointly by design and dev. Here’s how everyone stays in lockstep to ship at record speed.

## [Rabbit hole](#rabbit-hole)

Illustrations by Cynthia Alfonso and Lorenzo Gritti

![ 1. A series of interconnected green circles form a random pattern 2. An illustrated portrait of a man with dark, curly hair and a beard 3. A supergraphic formed of blue, green, orange, and pink shapes](data:image/png;base64,)![ 1. A series of interconnected green circles form a random pattern 2. An illustrated portrait of a man with dark, curly hair and a beard 3. A supergraphic formed of blue, green, orange, and pink shapes](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/599r6htc/regionalized/5a9a48ae7e4efbb2638babfb0f969834993a1414-1300x730.png?rect=0,1,1300,729&w=804&h=451&q=75&fit=max&auto=format)

1\. #DesignTwitter erupts after [Daryl Ginn tweets](https://twitter.com/darylginn/status/1752215572820136023) that design systems are no fun, with others claiming that they [stifle creativity](https://twitter.com/_kounzt/status/1752246073328869825) and lead to generic interfaces.

2\. [Pascal Potvin says](https://shaping.design/p/the-design-system-dilemma-striking): Why not both? Efficient _and_ boring, it’s on designers to leverage them effectively. Dan Mall suggests [leaving 20%](https://dribbble.com/resources/creativity-and-design-systems) to creativity.

3\. Bring your spicy takes to [the design systems track at Config](https://config.figma.com/) this June. See you there!
